tools.web: Word editor chat card and optional user-triggered image insertion

tools.web: Verified analysis delivery download applied through the open editor's fenced AnalysisDocumentTarget
tools.rationale: Inserts a committed PNG/JPEG Coding artifact (size and SHA-256 re-verified, header dimensions checked) into the open Word or PowerPoint document with provenance. Unsaved until the normal document save; refused if the document changed after capture.

tools.web: Session-bound frozen data-result API applied through the open editor's fenced AnalysisDocumentTarget
tools.rationale: Inserts rows read from the server's frozen query snapshot (hash-checked across pages, bounded by analysis insert limits) as a native table; values never come from model text. Unsaved until the normal document save; refused if the document changed after capture.
Requires a connected authorized peer and current document/run binding; bounded instructions and explicit input IDs only. Queued acknowledgement is not success; parent continuation is fenced.
Depends on the current document channel and non-revoked peers; task acknowledgements and states are not completed results.

tools.web: Session-bound published workspace source metadata API
tools.rationale: Metadata-only published enabled source names and IDs. No external source connection, table inspection, query, result save, or document mutation.
